title: When the Escarpment Wakes
premise: Ivo Zhou, a desert ranger who has spent years outrunning a wrongful conviction, tracks a thief named Sable across the salt flats and into a tide-revealed cave that turns out to be the hidden treasury of the escarpment's original inhabitants. The thief is not stealing for herself but to buy back her family's seized land before the concession permits expire, and Ivo, forced into an uneasy alliance with Sable and the cave's last living guardian, must lead them over the range ahead of the early snows. Pursued by the concession company's enforcers who want the cave sealed and its claim buried, they race the weather and the paperwork alike. In the end Ivo surrenders himself to a frontier court to testify against the company, trading his freedom for the community's legal standing — and finds that belonging was never something he could run toward, only build where he stood.
about_author: Lior Iversen is the pen name of a former trail-crew foreman who spent eleven seasons mapping high desert routes before turning to fiction. They write adventure stories about people who belong to landscapes more than institutions.

chapters.title: Salt and Warrants
chapters.summary: Ivo Zhou's POV. Tracking a thief across the flats, Ivo reflects on why he never stops moving: rest invites questions about his forged papers and old conviction. He corners the thief, Sable, at a dry well, but she escapes with his water and his warrant file. Beat: restless competence masking loneliness.

chapters.title: The Tide Opens
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Cornered on the coast by Ivo and a storm surge, she shelters in a sea cave revealed only at low tide — and Ivo follows her in. Inside they find carved archives, sealed doors, and an old woman, Maren, who calls herself the last warden. Beat: wonder cracking open hostility.

chapters.title: What the Company Buried
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. She shows them records proving the concession permits were built on falsified surveys erasing the escarpment peoples' claims. Sable confesses she meant to steal proof, not treasure, to save her family's farm. Enforcers arrive at the cave mouth. Beat: the past becomes urgent.

chapters.title: Three Strangers, One Rope
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Fleeing through the cave's upper galleries, the three are roped together crossing a collapsed span; Ivo nearly falls saving Sable's satchel of documents. They agree to cross the range ahead of the snows to reach the registry office before permits finalize. Beat: reluctant trust forged in danger.

chapters.title: Switchbacks
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. The climb tests them: Maren's age shows, Sable's guilt over endangering her family surfaces, and Ivo admits his conviction was engineered by the same company. A patrol drone spots their fire. Beat: confessions traded like rations, walls coming down.

chapters.title: The Frozen Pass
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Early snows catch them at the pass; they shelter three days in a shepherd hut, sharing stories, becoming something like family. Maren teaches Ivo the warden's oath. When the sky clears, the pass is half-closed and enforcers wait below. Beat: warmth inside the cold, dread outside it.

chapters.title: Descent Into Wind
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. They descend the treacherous windward face, Maren collapsing from altitude sickness; Sable carries her while Ivo runs ahead to draw off the enforcers, getting captured deliberately. Beat: sacrifice as love made practical; the found family holds even when split.

chapters.title: The Registry at Dusk
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. With hours before permits expire, Sable and a feverish Maren reach the registry office, but the clerk refuses unnotarized documents. Sable stands up publicly, telling the crowd the truth of the cave and the falsified surveys. Beat: courage without guarantees.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In the company's custody, Ivo chooses to testify openly under his real name, surrendering his fugitive life to expose the survey fraud and his own wrongful conviction. His testimony validates Sable's claim and triggers a formal review of the concessions. Beat: justice chosen over safety.

chapters.title: When the Escarpment Wakes
chapters.summary: Rotating final POVs. Spring: the permits are suspended pending review, Sable's family farm is protected, and Maren trains new wardens including Sable. Ivo, sentenced to light service rather than prison, stays — first time he has ever chosen to remain. Beat: belonging earned, home built, not fled to.
